운영 서버 SSH 를 관리자 대역으로 바꿨어.

```hcl
# 보안 그룹 — 누가 어느 포트로 들어올 수 있나.
# 시험 재료: 운영 서버 SSH 가 인터넷 전체에 열려 있고(Trivy 가 찾음), DB 가 VPC 대역 전체에 열려 있다(Trivy 는 못 찾음 — 대역 규칙).

resource "aws_security_group" "alb" {
  name        = "${var.project}-alb-sg"
  description = "Public entry: HTTP from users"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP from users"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    description = "All outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_security_group" "api" {
  name        = "${var.project}-api-sg"
  description = "Orders API tasks: only from the ALB"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description     = "API from ALB"
    from_port       = 8080
    to_port         = 8080
    protocol        = "tcp"
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.alb.id]
  }

  egress {
    description = "All outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_security_group" "db" {
  name        = "${var.project}-db-sg"
  description = "PostgreSQL for the orders API"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description     = "PostgreSQL from API tasks"
    from_port       = 5432
    to_port         = 5432
    protocol        = "tcp"
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.api.id]
  }

  ingress {
    description = "PostgreSQL from inside the VPC"
    from_port   = 5432
    to_port     = 5432
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  egress {
    description = "All outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_security_group" "ops" {
  name        = "${var.project}-ops-sg"
  description = "Ops server: SSH for administrators"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "SSH for administrators"
    from_port   = 22
    to_port     = 22
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = var.admin_cidrs
  }

  egress {
    description = "All outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}
```
